notes: Excel file with multiple sheets (ILS / USD). The ILS sheet has multiple card sections — detect header row by looking for 'תאריך עסקה'. Only process rows belonging to 'ויזה מקס' / 'Visa MAX' sections (not Mastercard sections). Between sections there may be summary rows — skip any row missing a valid numeric amount. Positive amounts = expenses (out), negative = refund/credit (in). If currency_original (מטבע עסקה) differs from ILS, store it as amount_original/currency_original.
